name: Lesante Blu Exclusive Beach Resort
positioning: All-suite Leading Hotels of the World member in the village of Tragaki on Zakynthos, with a private beach and views of the Ionian Sea
best_for: Couples who want suites with private pools and a secluded private beach
Travelers who want private yacht excursions around Zakynthos and nearby islands

facts.text: Lesante Blu is located in the village of Tragaki on Zakynthos.
Lesante Blu is an all-suite hotel and a member of The Leading Hotels of the World.
The hotel looks out over the Ionian Sea.
The restaurants offer creative Greek and Mediterranean dishes by the sea.
Gaia Restaurant is one of the hotel's restaurants.
Ostria All Day Restaurant Bar is the a la carte restaurant by the pool.
The Royal Grand Suite has a sea view and a private pool.
Suite types include a Spa Suite with an outdoor jetted tub.
The hotel has a secluded private beach.

highlights.text: A jetty platform is used for private excursions on the hotel's own yachts around Zakynthos and nearby islands.
Private yacht excursions depart directly from the pier.
The hotel has a private helipad.
The hotel has private infinity pools.
Melia Fine Dining is the hotel's fine-dining restaurant.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the property is adults-only.
The hotel is in the village of Tragaki on Zakynthos.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
